newsitem.title: ITALY: Italians tried to cash in on mother's corpse.
newsitem.headline: Italians tried to cash in on mother's corpse.

text.p: Two Italians kept their mother's corpse at their home so they could continue to draw her pension, newspapers reported on Tuesday.
The pair, named only as Francesco, 43, and his sister Rosaria, 32, hoped no one would notice that their 76-year-old mother had died, the reports said.

The body was discovered last Saturday when another son visited the home the two shared with the woman in the northwestern port of Genoa. He noticed the smell and called the police, La Stampa newspaper said.
It quoted a coroner as saying the woman had probably died two weeks ago from natural causes.
Her son and daughter, both unemployed, faced charges of fraud and abuse of a corpse, the reports said. Police were not available for comment.
